title: PAR-139.3 bounded SPATIAL_FILTER owner-graph preflight
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Resolve INSERT extension dictionaries to ACAD_FILTER dictionaries and SPATIAL_FILTER targets independent of callback order
Reject ambiguous identities, case-folded dictionary key collisions, dangling targets, and incorrect owners
Follow filter-owned extension dictionaries only when all children resolve to owned typed XRECORDs
Retain fail-closed output until graph serialization is implemented
localEvidence: Generated ASCII and Binary inputs contain two INSERT instances of one block name with separate clip owner graphs
The complete generated graph sets ownerGraphComplete but remains refused with spatial-filter-serializer-not-implemented
Generated dangling-target and cross-owned-filter mutations are rejected before publication

assessment.planImpact: Adds an executable bounded owner-closure check for the known XCLIP dictionary route. A closed graph still cannot emit output and does not qualify visual clipping or inversion semantics.

method.limitations: The generated graph exercises typed DICTIONARY and XRECORD identity checks. No serializer, XCLIP geometry evaluation, native CAD display, or external consumer qualification is implemented in this slice.

nextAction: Implement PAR-139.4 serializer scheduling for the complete graph with role-aware handle remapping; preserve the existing destination and permit retry on the same adapter after correction.
